items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Complies with ASTM C1116/ C1116M, Type III fiber reinforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508.
Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Class 1b .

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The unopened boxes can be stored for indefinite period in a dry environment, protected from direct sunlight.

items.label: Concrete mixing time
items.text: Place the bag directly into the ready mixed truck or central mixer. Mix for a minimum of three (3) minutes or until fibres are evenly distributed through concrete.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text:
The recommended minimum dose rate of Sika® Confibre® 19F is 0.9kg (1 bag) per cubic metre of concrete.
Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
